cells.gaps: No source found says newborns now receive the NNI at birth registration. A March 2025 conference remark that the birth registration remains the ID number disagrees with ONECI's later plans to start giving it in maternities.
cells.note: ONECI said in June 2025 it was working to give newborns an NNI in maternities and in September 2026 that a campaign to create identities on the day of birth would soon start: provided for, stage 2. The newest facts stand over the vaguer 2025 remark.
